sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A target cannot move freely, though it may still act from position.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use when physically trapped, grabbed, bound, or pinned.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use when physically trapped, grabbed, bound, or pinned.
